comparison.objective: Prime an inhaler away from a resident and place it on a tray; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-795 tests reorientation and repeated canister pressing; candidate tests fine tool use, collar rotation, locking, and dynamic machine trials.
comparison.success_condition: PR-795 requires at least two safe-direction sprays and forbids spraying toward the resident; other numeric details are absent and no spec versions exist. Candidate uses mechanical performance thresholds.
comparison.reason: Safe priming does not exercise mechanical tuning or retained adjustment.
